Meal costs rise due to tomato, LPG price pressures: Crisil

Household meal costs are expected to remain high, according to a Crisil report. The increase is attributed to rising prices of tomatoes, LPG, and broiler chicken, which have outpaced a drop in potato prices. This trend impacts both vegetarian and non-vegetarian thalis.
